name: zeabur
description: Zeabur CLI skills for deployment, template management, server management, and troubleshooting

interface.shortDescription: Deploy apps, manage services and servers, and troubleshoot on Zeabur
interface.longDescription: Zeabur is a cloud platform for deploying and operating applications, databases, and dedicated servers. This plugin teaches Codex to drive the official Zeabur CLI end to end: deploy a project from local source or from GitHub, create projects and services, manage environment variables and databases, read build and runtime logs, publish and deploy templates, rent dedicated servers, scale Kubernetes node pools, and register domains with their DNS records. It also bundles troubleshooting playbooks for the failures teams hit most — port mismatches, startup-order and migration deadlocks, and broken service URLs. Everything runs through the zeabur CLI on your own machine using your existing Zeabur login. This plugin ships skills only: no MCP server and no additional credentials.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this project to Zeabur and give me the public URL.
My Zeabur service keeps restarting — check the runtime logs and tell me why.
List my Zeabur servers and show what plans are available to rent.
